description: This is a support/utility source file for Cypress test automation. It defines custom Cypress commands related to login, form interactions, notifications, and element manipulations for testing the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login by visiting login page and submitting username and password via form.

methods.name: loginTo
methods.description: Performs login to a specified URL with given credentials, with optional additional request options.

methods.name: apiLogin
methods.description: Performs API login by sending a POST request with username and password to authentication endpoint.

methods.name: getOXD
methods.description: Fetches an OXD element based on provided type.

methods.name: getOXDInput
methods.description: Finds and retrieves an input element based on its label, with Cypress logging and error handling.

methods.name: toast
methods.description: Checks for a toast message of a specific type with the given message.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of an input or textarea element and dispatches an 'input' event.

methods.name: isInvalid
methods.description: Verifies whether a form element displays an invalid message.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects an option from a dropdown or select element based on the value.
